start: Member, Play store install, a newer MettleUp is out, app opened on the Workout tab, no workout open

user_sees: Full screen: 'A new MettleUp is here'
'It downloads while you keep using the app. Your workouts stay safe.'
Numbered lines of what is new
Buttons 'Update now' and 'Later'
must_not: The full screen shows over the welcome screens or over a screen opened on top of the tabs
The full screen shows while a workout is open

user_sees: The button shows it is busy
The full screen closes and the orange line on the Workout tab says the new version is downloading
must_not: A second download starts on a second tap
A workout or routine is lost

steps.action: Keep using the app until the download is done
user_sees: Sheet: 'The new version is ready to install'
'Tap "Restart now" to open the new version. It takes a few seconds. Your workouts stay safe.'
Buttons 'Restart now' and 'Later'
must_not: The sheet shows during an open workout
The app restarts without the member tapping

user_sees: The app closes and opens again on the new version
must_not: Saved workouts, routines or settings missing after the restart

start: Member, a newer version waits, the member tapped 'Later' earlier

user_sees: The slim orange line at the top: 'A new version of MettleUp is ready' with 'Update' and a 'What's new' link
must_not: No way left to update after 'Later'
A close button that hides the line for good

user_sees: The same numbered lines as the full screen, inside the line
The link now says 'Hide what's new'
must_not: An empty list
The link shown when there are no lines

user_sees: The download starts, or the full screen's action runs
must_not: Nothing happens on the tap

start: Member, sideloaded (GitHub) install, a newer version is out

user_sees: 'A new MettleUp is here'
'Tap "Update now" to download the file, then open it to install. Your workouts stay safe.'
must_not: The Play words shown on a GitHub install

user_sees: The phone's download of the new file starts
must_not: A Play Store page that cannot update a sideloaded app

start: Member, a newer version waits, a workout is open

steps.action: Start a workout from the Workout tab, then go back to the tabs
user_sees: No full screen
The orange line words for an open workout; the update installs after the workout
must_not: The full screen or the restart sheet over a running workout
The app restarting mid-workout

steps.action: Press Android back on the full screen when it shows later
user_sees: The full screen closes like 'Later'
must_not: The app closing
The full screen coming back at once

start: Member, the full screen is showing

user_sees: The full screen closes
The orange line stays on the Workout tab
must_not: The full screen again on the next tab switch

steps.action: Leave the app for more than 6 hours, come back
user_sees: The check runs again as a new launch; the full screen may show again
must_not: The full screen on every return within 6 hours

user_sees: The orange line is gone
must_not: The line or full screen still offering the version now installed

steps.action: Read the full screen and the line
user_sees: Only version words and what is new
must_not: Any workout, body weight or gym data shown or sent by the update check
